scripts.backend:build: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && pyinstaller backend_server.spec --noconfirm --workpath build_backend --distpath dist
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "cross-env VITE_API_PORT=8010 npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=1 ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 BIDMANAGER_PORT=8010 electron ."
scripts.electron:dist: npm run frontend:build && npm run backend:build && electron-builder --win nsis
